objective: List the fixed USD 250 Local Knowledge Terminal collection-fit sprint where buyers already look for bounded technical services, without weakening the free fit check, privacy gate, or received-revenue accounting.

offer.gross_milestone: Four confirmed USD 250 payments equal USD 1,000 gross before platform and payout fees, taxes, refunds, and delivery costs.
offer.scope_policy: The marketplace route must preserve one collection, one language goal, one existing machine, a 12-source-unit and 20-question sample cap, up to two cited browser cards, one factual correction pass, the written map and go/no-go decision, the existing exclusions, and the selected draft commitments below. It must not invent or add an unrecorded turnaround, support promise, benchmark, or customer result.

channels.economics: At a USD 250 service price, the current Free plan charges the client a USD 15 Contra platform fee plus the applicable payment-processing fee. The independent keeps the USD 250 service amount before payout-processor or currency-conversion fees, taxes, refunds, and delivery costs. Verify the live checkout before quoting any client total.
channels.fit: Best first route. Contra Services supports a one-time price, requirements, examples, and an inquiry before the work is contracted, which preserves the free collection-fit discussion.
activation_gates: The operator registers once, reviews and accepts the current terms, and confirms the intended LazyingArt business identity.
The operator completes Persona identity verification and a supported payout route; no agent submits identity or bank information.
The live service editor is checked for current tags, media rules, fee display, contract flow, cancellation terms, and any required schedule or revision fields.
The final preview uses the exact delivery, concurrency, correction, cancellation, refund, confidentiality, retention, and support commitments recorded in the listing packet.
The public sample report is used only as project-owned evidence, never as a customer result or testimonial.
Inquiry, proposal, contract, payment, revisions, and delivery evidence stay in the platform workflow when its rules require that.
The final listing preview preserves the source-rights, privacy, custom-OCR, hardware, and production-deployment boundaries.

channels.economics: The freelancer fee is currently 0% to 15% per contract and is shown before proposal or offer acceptance. A USD 250 contract therefore produces USD 212.50 to USD 250 before payout fees, taxes, refunds, and delivery costs; four marketplace sales do not guarantee USD 1,000 net.
channels.fit: Strong fixed-scope mechanics and work-sample support, but Project Catalog requires explicit delivery days and revisions and reviews every listing. Use only after those operating commitments are selected.

channels.economics: Fiverr currently pays a freelancer 80% of the completed purchase amount. A USD 250 order produces USD 200 before payout fees, taxes, refunds, and delivery costs, so five completed unreversed orders would be needed to reach USD 1,000 before those costs.
channels.fit: Weakest first route. A directly orderable Gig is less compatible with the mandatory free fit check and sensitive collection scoping. Reconsider only after repeated deliveries make the scope safe to purchase without a pre-sale ambiguity.

contra_listing_packet.title: Audit a Private Document Collection for Local AI Search

cover_asset.evidence_boundary: Project-owned, AI-assisted concept cover grounded in the documented LKT prototype and interface. It is not a customer result, testimonial, benchmark, shipped hardware product, or proof of a paid engagement.

contra_listing_packet.one_line: A bounded decision sprint for one authorized PDF, book, dictionary, or text collection that should stay on an existing local machine.
contra_listing_packet.description: Trying to decide whether a private collection belongs in a local, cited knowledge workflow? The free fit discussion first checks the collection, intended use, language goal, readers, source rights, privacy constraints, sample format, and existing machine. If the fit and written scope are accepted, the fixed USD 250 sprint covers one collection, one language goal, and one existing machine. You receive a written data, citation, and privacy map; evaluation of an agreed sample capped at 12 source units and 20 test questions; up to two cited browser cards when the source is usable; a written go/no-go recommendation; and one factual correction pass. Hardware, shipping, custom OCR, bulk conversion, production deployment, and ongoing support are excluded.
requirements: Describe the collection and the task a reader should be able to perform; do not attach confidential source material during the first inquiry.
State the language goal and intended readers.
Confirm that you have the right to use the material.
Describe the format and approximate size, including whether PDFs are searchable text or scanned images.
Describe the existing machine and any offline or privacy constraint.
evidence: Use https://lazying.art/lkt/sample-report/ as the first portfolio or media item when the live platform permits the link or attachment; let the project-owned proof precede the inquiry step.
Label every interface or generated product image as project-owned proof or a prototype-grounded concept.
Do not use the existing Reddit acknowledgement as a testimonial; it concerns a separate free educational archive.

public_terms.policy: The future Contra preview must match this public contract exactly before publication.

publication_commitments.delivery_window: Ten business days after the written scope is accepted, platform payment is secured, and the complete agreed sample and machine-access path are available. The delivery clock pauses while required material, access, or answers are missing.
publication_commitments.correction_window: One consolidated factual correction pass of up to ten items submitted within seven calendar days after delivery. Errors against the written scope are corrected; new sources, questions, languages, formats, interfaces, deployment work, or preferences are a new scope.
publication_commitments.cancellation_and_refund: Cancel before source transfer or processing begins for a full refund. After work begins, LazyingArt retains only the fixed allocation for each completed and delivered item above and refunds the undelivered balance. If the source rights, format, privacy needs, or machine path materially differ from the accepted fit, work stops and the unearned balance is refunded. Accepted completed deliverables are not refundable except where the platform or applicable law requires it.
publication_commitments.confidentiality_and_retention: Customer material is used only for the accepted sprint, is not published or reused as portfolio evidence without separate written permission, and is handled through the agreed transfer and processing path. Working source copies are deleted within fourteen calendar days after acceptance, cancellation, or refund unless the written scope requires an earlier deletion or applicable recordkeeping rules require a limited record.
publication_commitments.support_boundary: Written clarification about the delivered report is available through the platform during the seven-day correction window. Hosting, monitoring, deployment, maintenance, retraining, hardware support, additional meetings, and ongoing operation are excluded.

remaining_live_editor_checks: Confirm the exact available Contra role, tool, and industry tags and choose only directly relevant tags.
Preview the cover crop and retain the visible SOFTWARE SERVICE · HARDWARE NOT INCLUDED disclosure.
Verify the current client fee display and contract flow without advertising a fixed client total.
Save as unpublished first and compare every field with this packet before publication.
contra_listing_packet.revenue_policy: A listing view, inquiry, proposal, signed contract, platform balance, or pending payout is not received revenue. Record the sale and money only after the platform payment and private evidence meet the existing metrics gates.
